metadata.title: Ethiopia Exposure Grid
sources: FAO Gridded Livestock of the World v4 (2015) cattle/sheep/goats, 5 arcmin (Harvard Dataverse, dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/glw_4)
metadata.method: Population and TLU-weighted livestock headcount summed per 0.5-degree grid cell, then log1p + 95th-percentile normalized to 0-1 and combined 50/50 into `exposure`.
